title: Event-Driven Chat Bot Refactor
prompt:
Refactor a chat room away from global bot callbacks. Implement `EventBus`, `ChatRoom`, `AwayBot`, `MeetingBot`, and `TacoBot`. `EventBus.subscribe(name, callback)` registers callbacks in order; `emit(name, payload)` invokes a snapshot of those callbacks synchronously. `ChatRoom.register(bot)` attaches one bot. `send(sender, text)` appends the original user message to `history`, emits `message_received`, and returns without direct bot-to-bot calls. Bots may append a bot message through their room and emit their own domain event.

`AwayBot(owner)` toggles its private away state when its owner sends `/away`; while away, it adds one bot reply to messages from other users. `MeetingBot` emits `meeting_started` for messages beginning `/meet `. `TacoBot` accepts `/taco recipient`, increments only its own recipient balance, and adds an acknowledgement. Bot-generated messages append after the original message. Invalid taco commands do nothing. Keep every bot's state isolated per instance.

example.output: a user message followed by one away reply
example.reasoning: The room owns message ordering while bot state remains encapsulated.
